# purpleDrop

> purpleDrop (purpledrop.com) is a senior-only team that designs and builds fast, clear websites for small and mid-sized businesses. Fixed price, agreed in writing before work starts. Yours to keep.

We work with established businesses in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Australia.

## Services
- The Starter. A focused 3-5 page site: home, services, about, contact.
- The Business Site. A 5-10 page site with a content system you can update yourself.
- The Redesign. A straight assessment of what is wrong, then a rebuild and migration.
- The Care Plan. Hosting, updates, backups, and a monthly report.

Every engagement is a fixed price, agreed in writing before work starts. No hourly billing.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://purpledrop.com/): Overview of the approach.
- [Services](https://purpledrop.com/services): The services in detail.
- [Process](https://purpledrop.com/process): How an engagement works, step by step.
- [Results](https://purpledrop.com/results): How we report what we measure.
- [Essays](https://purpledrop.com/resources): Plain-English writing on websites and AI visibility.
- [Contact](https://purpledrop.com/contact): Book a free 30-minute first call.
- [About](https://purpledrop.com/about): Who does the work.

## Facts
- Small, senior-only team - the people you meet do the work.
- We are NOT a traditional agency and we do not guarantee specific AI rankings or positions; nobody can honestly promise that.
- If a company is already well described by AI, we say so on the first call rather than selling unnecessary work.
- Pricing is fixed and quoted in writing before work starts.
